main.title: MIT 18.01: Single Variable Calculus
main.why: Limits and derivatives, approximation and optimization, the definite integral and the fundamental theorems, integration techniques, and infinite series. In English.

main.title: MIT 18.02: Multivariable Calculus
main.why: Vectors and matrices, partial derivatives, gradients and the chain rule, Lagrange multipliers, multiple integrals, and the theorems of Green, Gauss and Stokes. In English.

main.title: MIT 18.063: Matrix Calculus for Machine Learning and Beyond
main.why: Derivatives as linear maps, gradients and Jacobians of matrix functions, forward- and reverse-mode chain rules, and adjoint methods. In English.

main.title: Convex Optimization
main.why: Convex sets and functions, convex problems such as least squares, linear and semidefinite programs, duality, and interior-point methods. In English.
